evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter, top and silhouette all read instantly as a flanged pipe run (L-drop, S-jog, flared end flanges with bolt nubs); no floating or sunk parts, all 16 bolts seated (gap 0, penetration 0.03-0.06).
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big teal tube run, medium gold flanges/coupling at joints and ends, small dark octagonal bolt heads spaced around each flange.
evidence.V3: Confident chunky stylisation: oversized flanges vs tube diameter, soft wide bends; tube stays fairly uniform/thin on the long straights but reads stylised, not stiff.
evidence.V4: Bevels inconsistent: coupling flange shows only a faint edge highlight and the end-bore flange face/rim reads nearly razor-edged in studio close-up, unlike the clear light-catching chamfer strip on the flanges elsewhere in the kit.
evidence.V5: Smooth shading on tubes and bends is clean in studio and flat close-ups; no pinches, seams, z-fighting or flipped faces (A17/A18 pass, 0 self-intersections, 0 flipped); only low-segment polygonal rims on flanges, consistent with kit.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one hue (teal) + kit gold accent + ink-dark bolts, good value contrast; colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the hue cleanly.
evidence.V7: 1632 tris vs medium class target 2000 / ceiling 4000: under target.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material with vertex colours, kit gold/ink/hue palette and flange/bolt language match the kit pipe anchor; only bevel visibility slightly weaker.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, Hull collision, CanTouch off, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre (A12 pass).

artifacts: End-bore flange and coupling flange edges show little/no visible chamfer (near-razor rim in studio light)
Flange outer rims and elbow outline visibly polygonal (low segment count) in close-ups
Open bore reads as a flat black disc with no visible inner wall
top_fixes: Add/enlarge the ~0.045 stud chamfer on flange faces and rims so edges catch light consistently, especially the end-bore flange
Raise flange rim segment count slightly (budget allows: 1632/2000) to soften the polygonal outline
Give the open bore a short visible inner wall or darker-teal interior so the opening reads with depth
